rewards.name: GOLDEN PASS
rewards.description: Skip one card without receiving a punishment.

rewards.name: SECOND CHANCE
rewards.description: Discard your current card and draw another from the same deck.

rewards.name: SHIELD
rewards.description: Avoid one punishment when choosing NO COMMENT.

rewards.name: LUCKY DRAW
rewards.description: Draw two cards from your chosen deck and pick one.

rewards.name: TIME OUT
rewards.description: Skip your next turn without penalty.

rewards.name: KEEP THE SPOTLIGHT
rewards.description: After completing your next challenge, take another turn.

rewards.name: WILD CARD
rewards.description: Choose a different deck after seeing your first card.

rewards.name: REWIND
rewards.description: Return your current card and draw a fresh one.

rewards.name: FREE CHOICE
rewards.description: Choose any deck for your next turn.

rewards.name: DOUBLE OR NOTHING
rewards.description: Draw a second card and attempt both without spending another token.

rewards.name: YOUR PROBLEM NOW
rewards.description: Choose another player to draw an additional card.

rewards.name: PICK YOUR POISON
rewards.description: Choose the deck another player must draw from on their next turn.

rewards.name: HOT SEAT
rewards.description: Choose another player to take the next turn.

rewards.name: TAG, YOU'RE IT
rewards.description: Choose another player to draw from the same deck as you.

rewards.name: DEALER'S CHOICE
rewards.description: Choose the deck another player must draw from.

rewards.name: ENCORE
rewards.description: Choose another player to draw an additional card after their next challenge.

rewards.name: SWITCHEROO
rewards.description: Swap your next turn with another willing player.

rewards.name: DOUBLE TROUBLE
rewards.description: Choose another player to draw two cards and pick one.

rewards.name: THE SPOTLIGHT
rewards.description: Choose another player to take an immediate turn.

rewards.name: GROUP PRESSURE
rewards.description: Choose another player to draw from the Cross the Line deck.
